comparison.objective: Seat and clasp a springform pan, then pour batter without leaking or spilling; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered base seating, over-center clasping, and controlled pouring versus long rigid-part support, compliant prong insertion, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Pan sealed before pour, volume delivered, spill/leak limits, and jug set down versus four-prong retention, rack-level match, and correct screws.
comparison.reason: The shared notions of seating and latching are generic; the fluid-transfer objective and mechanics are substantially different.
